name: PS1 / PS2 nostalgic
about: Late PS1 / early PS2: a low-res frame, crisp nearest-filtered photo texels, 15-bit dither, tape wear; the old nostalgic finish for Nintendo/PS1/PS2-era asks.
characters: ps1char: a photo cut-out turned into a ~450-triangle rigged body with 128 px PS1 faces (CHARACTERS.md, tools/ps1char/)
surfaces: designTex on CC0 photos, read as blocky nearest low-res texels (terrain.retro, src/scenario/retrotex.js)
light: real sources, terrain.lightModel 'real'; path-traced at 256 samples to judge
finish: terrain.finish, the old nostalgic tape finish (src/scenario/finish.js)
